proof_scope: local deterministic semantic validation of source-bound process requirements plus measured Graphviz SVG geometry validation

claims.proves: the checker preserves required gated-process semantics, returns concrete precondition-bypass paths, distinguishes independent fanout from ordered escalation, and detects selected overlaps/intersections/overflow in actual Graphviz SVG output
claims.does_not_prove: that requirements were initially extracted correctly; Mermaid or Excalidraw geometry; universal curve collision freedom; or human comprehension at intended reading size

cases.name: live-graphviz-render-and-measured-scene-check
command: D=$(mktemp -d); trap 'rm -rf "$D"' EXIT; printf 'digraph G { rankdir=TB; node [shape=box]; start [label="Start"]; done [label="Done"]; start -> done [label="ok"]; }\n' > "$D/live.dot"; dot -Tsvg "$D/live.dot" > "$D/live.svg"; ../run.sh geometry "$D/live.svg" --json
